summary: Moved all runtime responsibilities and editorial resources into skills/prosevoice. New prosevoice_lib modules: essay.py (extract, premise, READY via the shared config; sibling import removed), policy.py (additive Harper policy and lint wrapper; private legacy resolver removed) and rules.py (check, PROSEVOICE-PROTOCOL.md targets with OpenCode/path dedup, conservative parameterized managed-block parser shared with migration, preview-by-default rule that refuses all writes on malformed blocks). The CLI now exposes check, rule, policy, lint, extract, premise and ready under the 0/1/2 envelope. Essay operations without --project use each essay's own Git root, which preserves per-project policy isolation. SKILL.md and the 12 agents were copied and their callers rewritten to the pv CLI; the editorial text is otherwise unchanged. pyproject ships SKILL, agents, protocol, Harper policy and templates. The three legacy test modules were ported with all 19 tests and their assertions intact; tests/test_prosevoice_runtime.py (23 tests) and tests/test_prosevoice_rules.py (18 tests) were added. 110 tests OK, ruff clean, wheel builds with all resources. Legacy skill trees are byte-unchanged, pending removal in the integration step.

interface_differences: READY blocked exit 3 -> 1; Harper unavailable exit 4 -> 0 with data.status skipped and harper-unavailable diagnostic
all helper output wrapped in the JSON envelope; results under data
--cwd replaced by --project; essay operations default to each essay's own Git root
rule no longer strips legacy blog-voice/pv-protocol blocks (migration-only)
remaining_for_later_steps: legacy tree removal and doc updates
